authority: Gary explicitly approved role-locked mixed-provider research data for INTRA-001 after Alpaca v2 proved OHLCV capability but not the complete reference contract.
note: This amendment changes ONLY the data-provider methodology. Every non-data-source rule in INTRA-001-v1 remains unchanged.
provider_role_principle: Provider mixing is allowed ONLY across explicitly assigned roles. A field may not silently switch providers during the study. No fallback provider is allowed inside either authoritative role.
reference_provider_role: symbol/reference identity required for monthly membership

preferred_join_key_hierarchy: stable provider-supported identifier when demonstrably available and historically valid
exact ticker + effective date when no stable cross-provider ID is available
cross_provider_join_policy.symbol_change_collision_policy: Any unresolved identifier collision makes the affected symbol ineligible and must be surfaced.
